The Sprint 3 review on 21 Oct closed Sprint 3, started Sprint 4, added six stories and eight tasks and changed several stories' criteria. `docs/backlog/` was last synced on 20 Oct, so reviewers checking a Sprint 4 PR against its story file would read stale criteria.

**Acceptance criteria**

1. Every Jira story, task and subtask has a file in `docs/backlog/`, including the new SCRUM-207 to SCRUM-220.
2. Each file's status, sprint, epic, points and description match Jira on the day of the sync; a file is rewritten only where Jira changed.
3. The index in `docs/backlog/README.md` lists every story and task with its current sprint and status, and its totals include the points committed to Sprint 4.
4. The sync date in the index and in each rewritten file is the day of the sync.
